test_title: PYST 41 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: What sum will amount to Rs. 23958 in 3 years at the rate of 10 percent per annum at compound interest (cormpounding annually)?
solution:
**Given:**

Amount = Rs. 23958

Rate = 10% per annum

Time = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest Formula: A = P × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

Where:

A = Final Amount

P = Principal

r = Rate of Interest

n = Time Period

**Calculation:**

⇒ 23958 = P × (1 + 10/100)³

⇒ 23958 = P × (1.1)³

⇒ 23958 = P × 1.331

⇒ P = 23958 ÷ 1.331

⇒ P = 18000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 18000.**
